# ARTINEXT

> ARTINEXT is a digital-systems studio based in Tehran, Iran, working remotely with architecture, structural and MEP teams. It builds custom Revit content (parametric families, office libraries, library audits), custom digital tools (Revit plugins and add-ins, model QA/QC checkers, Dynamo scripts, model and data conversion tools) and office and workflow automation (software and data integration, operational dashboards). The site is bilingual: Persian at `/fa/` (the default) and English at `/en/`, with matching paths.

Every project starts from the client's own process, not a pre-built product. The studio states plainly that it is not a fit for installing an off-the-shelf template or a generic plugin without a process review, and it gives no price or estimate before the problem has been stated in full. Clients own what gets built; source and build instructions are handed over.

## Services

- [Revit plugin development](https://artinext.ir/en/revit-plugin-development/): Custom Revit plugins and add-ins for architecture, structural and MEP teams, studied against how the team actually works before any code is written. Covers the three problems plugins are bought to fix and the four things that set the size of the job.
- [Revit family creation](https://artinext.ir/en/revit-family-creation/): Parametric, lightweight Revit families for manufacturers and design offices, tested against the combinations that break content. Built work: a curtain-wall system delivered as two panel types on one shared frame.
- [Office automation for AEC companies](https://artinext.ir/en/aec-workflow-automation/): Office and workflow automation, software and data integration and operational dashboards for AEC companies and technical offices. Not Revit-specific; built work: one dashboard structure for two offices in two languages.

## Tehran

- [Revit plugin development in Tehran](https://artinext.ir/en/revit-plugin-development-tehran/): The plugin service for Tehran offices, with discovery and handover available in person.
- [Revit family creation in Tehran](https://artinext.ir/en/revit-family-creation-tehran/): The family service for Tehran manufacturers and offices, where the product can be measured in person rather than reconstructed from a brochure.
- [Office automation in Tehran](https://artinext.ir/en/workflow-automation-tehran/): The automation service for Tehran companies, including installation on the office's own network and in-person training.

## Studio

- [Home](https://artinext.ir/en/): Three frictions found in almost every office, three product paths, two tools recorded running (CAD to Revit, ETABS to Revit), the four-stage process (discover, define, build, evolve) and common questions.
- [Products](https://artinext.ir/en/products/): Three deliverables shown as they shipped: Revit families, tools on the Revit ribbon, and one office automation system.
- [Research and development](https://artinext.ir/en/research-development/): Staged prototyping. The measure of success is written down before anything is built, and one possible outcome is not building it.
- [About](https://artinext.ir/en/about/): The software the studio works in (Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, Rhino, Grasshopper, Dynamo) and what it does in each.
- [Contact](https://artinext.ir/en/contact/): Project brief form. Email artinext.ai@gmail.com, phone +98 930 525 3240, Instagram @artinext.ir.

## Articles

- [Articles index](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/): All articles, fa and en.
- [A custom Revit ribbon for Dynamo scripts: from a folder of graphs to an office menu](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/custom-revit-ribbon-dynamo/): Why Dynamo Player is a list rather than a menu, four ways to build a custom Revit tab (Dynamo Player folder, Relay, pyRevit, a C# add-in), preparing graphs with Is Input and Is Output to run from a button, organising panels by stage of work, rollout from one shared folder, Revit and Dynamo version planning, and when a graph should become a plugin.
- [Custom MEP Revit add-ins: from connectors to the office's rules](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/custom-mep-revit-add-ins/): How MEP add-ins walk connectors (MEPCurve, ConnectorManager, Flow, Direction, AllRefs), where MEP offices start (sizing against the office table, system naming, open connector checks, tagging, hangers), cable sizing in Revit 2026, the unit, direction, tee and nominal-size details that break add-ins, and Dynamo vs a custom add-in.
- [Revit wall post family automation: from wall rules to modelled posts](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-wall-post-automation/): What a wall post is, Iranian code limits on non-structural wall length and height taken as settings, a light wall post family, placement logic (FindInserts, mandatory points, even spans, height to beam soffit), wall direction and junction errors, reruns after design changes, and takeoff.
- [A Revit output management tool: from sheet set to issue register](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-output-management-tool/): Sheet sets, Revit 2022 PDF export with naming rules, Issued revisions, file names without Persian characters, the drawing issue register vs the transmittal, what an output tool does in order, and catching partial exports.
- [A Revit sheet sorting plugin: from the numbering rule to the issued set](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-sheet-sorting-plugin/): Browser Organization vs the Sheet Order parameter, why sheet numbers sort wrong (text, zero padding), swapping numbers through a temporary one, what a sorting plugin does, and locking numbers after the first issue.
- [Revit API development: what you can build, and what a dependable add-in takes](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-api-development/): What the Revit API is, five ways to program Revit (macros, Dynamo, pyRevit, compiled add-ins, Design Automation on APS), how an add-in is put together, the .NET 8 move in Revit 2025, and what real models demand.
- [A Revit room finishing automation plugin: what it builds, and the small details that break it](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-room-finishing-automation/): Room finish parameters vs modelled finishes, what a plugin builds from room boundaries (finish walls, floors, ceilings, skirting, cut openings), finish rules by room type, door thresholds and boundary gaps, updating after design changes, and finish takeoff.
- [MVP development for internal tools: the smallest version that answers one question](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/mvp-development-internal-tools/): What an MVP means when the users are your own staff, proof of concept vs prototype vs MVP, when an internal tool deserves one, writing the measure and the stop condition first, scope, testing on real files, and the three outcomes including not building it.
- [Software and data integration consulting: draw the data map before choosing a tool](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/software-data-integration-consulting/): The data map, one owner and one source per record, four ways to connect systems, Revit API, IFC and ISO 19650, Persian characters and Jalali dates, logging and reconciliation, and what integration consulting should deliver.
- [A custom AI assistant for business answers from your files, with the source attached](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/custom-ai-assistant-for-business/): The four parts of an assistant, custom vs licensed (Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise), choosing one job, retrieval-augmented generation, citations and declining, Persian text normalisation, permissions at retrieval, prompt injection, and testing with known answers.
- [A management dashboard for construction companies is only as good as its worst number](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/construction-management-dashboard/): Director, project and operations levels, starting from decisions rather than KPIs, where the numbers come from, what makes figures trustworthy, refresh rates, Jalali calendar and right-to-left, and Excel vs Power BI vs custom.
- [How to prepare company data for AI, starting with the files you already have](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/prepare-company-data-for-ai/): Starting from one question, finding data inside Revit models and drawing sets, naming and versions, cleaning Persian and English text, ownership, access, and what an AI readiness assessment should produce.
- [A Revit schedule to Excel export plugin is judged by the trip back](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-schedule-to-excel-export/): What Revit's native schedule export produces, cleaning it in Excel, what a plugin adds, and what a round trip back into the model must protect (element IDs, decimal-feet units, read-only fields, type vs instance).
- [CAD-to-Revit automation: what a converter builds, and what still needs a person](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/cad-to-revit-automation/): Link CAD vs Import CAD, what the drawing set needs first, how a converter classifies and places elements, Dynamo vs plugin vs service, and structure and MEP.
- [Choosing a Revit plugin development company: what actually matters](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-plugin-development-company/): Company, freelancer or in-house; the questions to ask before signing; comparing two quotes on scope rather than total.
- [Custom Dynamo script development: what it actually replaces](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/custom-dynamo-script-development/): What a Dynamo graph replaces, how to build one other people can run, what Revit upgrades do to packages, and when a graph should become an add-in.
- [Where AEC workflow automation should start](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/aec-workflow-automation/): Choosing the first process, writing it down, fixing the data behind it and piloting it before switching over.
- [Custom parametric Revit family creation: what makes a family actually work](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/custom-parametric-revit-family-creation/): Type and instance parameters, reference planes, formulas, and testing beyond a single flex.
- [How much does Revit plugin development cost?](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-plugin-development-cost/): The drivers behind plugin pricing (workflow complexity, integrations, user count, Revit versions) instead of a price list.
- [A Revit model checker automates QA/QC. It doesn't replace it.](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-model-checker/): Autodesk's Model Checker, building a checkset, triaging flags, and when a custom checker is the next step.
- [Revit library optimization isn't about deleting files](https://artinext.ir/en/articles/revit-library-optimization/): Purging, downloaded content, object styles, a written library standard and a recurring audit.
